name: Abdollah Khan Ustajlu
contribution: A high-ranking Iranian dignitary of Ustajlu Turkoman origin, who served during the reign of Shah Tahmasp I. He successively held the posts of amir al-omarāʾ and divanbegi, before becoming the governor of Shirvan from 1549 until 1565 or 1566.

checks.lead: Abdollah Khan Ustajlu (died 1566/67) was a high-ranking Iranian dignitary of Ustajlu Turkoman origin, who served during the reign of Shah Tahmasp I (1524–1576). He successively held the posts of amir al-omarāʾ (commander-in-chief) and divanbegi (chancellor, chief justice), before becoming the governor of Shirvan from 1549 until 1565 or 1566.
